newsitem.title: USA: Steel Technologies to buy Atlantic Coil.
newsitem.headline: Steel Technologies to buy Atlantic Coil.

text.p: Steel Technologies Inc said Monday it has reached an agreement to purchase Atlantic Coil Processing Inc for about $20 million.

The acquisition, said the company, is expected to be completed on April 1 and will add three new facilities in North Carolina to the eight operations currently run by Steel Technologies in the U.S. and Mexico.
The company said that Atlantic Coil is its first major acquisition and will place it ahead of schedule on its five-year business plan to double revenues by 2001.
The acquisition, said the company, will also positively impact earnings in 1998 and beyond.
